what: English link underline and the bent slash at its end — on hover the underline wipes off to the right end and the slash wipes downward over 35%, then they are redrawn from the opposite end (left, top) (.7s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1)) while the text shifts 8px right (.8s ease-out-circ). Once started it runs to the end for .7s even if you move away, and only then returns to normal. look: arrow is an arrow-line link where a single underline wipes off to the right in .4s and is redrawn from the left in .8s after .3s

options.lock: Wait time even after release during one spin (ms), default 700
options.look: arrow: Arrow-line link type — one underline, retracts in .4s · redraws in .8s (.3s late)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Underline (empty span, the consumer sets height and color)
options.[data-fx-part=slash]: Hatch lines at the end (one svg, optional)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Redraw length and curve, default .7s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1)
options.--fx-shift · --fx-shift-dur · --fx-shift: Text push distance, duration and curve, default 8px · .8s · cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)
options.--fx-out · --fx-in · --fx-gap: look: arrow retract · redraw · gap delay, default .4s · .8s · .3s

use: Contact Form
note: Not applied on hover-less devices (hover false)

from.where: All pages .ai-line (Contact and footer CONTACT FORM) · .ai-arrow (arrow row links on About and Services)
